configs.title: VENYX 24/7 AFK Auto All [Divine & 50B+ RAW Safe]
configs.desc:
⚠️ READ THIS FIRST
Always join the server with the best connection (lowest ping).

This config runs everything automatically. It protects Divine eggs and only handles RAW eggs worth 50B and above.

FEATURES
- Auto Steal (Teleport): secret, eternal, and Divine eggs
- Auto Sell: Cosmic eggs and below
- Auto Halloween Event
- Auto Pumpkin Moon
- Auto Farm Monster
- Auto Phantom Express
- Auto Buy Dimension Egg
- Auto Fishing
- Auto Shooting Star
- Auto Butterfly Bloom
- Auto Trade & Craft Essence
- Auto Place Egg (no Divine)
- Auto Treadmill
- Auto Hatch & Equip (no Divine)
- Auto Fuse Machine (no Divine)
- Auto Favorite (10B and above)
- Auto Apply Mutation (10B and above)
- Easy Quick Bar

HOW IT WORKS
1. Auto Steal: steals secret, eternal, and Divine eggs.
2. Auto Place Egg: places secret and eternal eggs only. Never Divine.
3. Auto Fuse Machine: fuses secret and eternal eggs only. Never Divine.
4. Auto Favorite and Auto Mutation: apply only to eggs worth 10B and above (Scramble, Enchanted, and Nitro).
5. Quick Bar: quick and easy access to your tools whenever you need them.

KNOWN ISSUES
Fishing and stealing at the same time in the main area may cause a little lag. A few small bugs are still around, so good luck!
